emailConfig.title: Email
emailConfig.description: Configure the SMTP server used to send e-mail from Shio.
emailConfig.serverDesc: Connection details for the outgoing mail (SMTP) server.
emailConfig.enabledHint: Enable to allow Shio to send e-mail through this server.
emailConfig.testConnectionHint: Verify the connection to the mail server when saving.
emailConfig.smtpAuthHint: Authenticate against the SMTP server with the username and password.
emailConfig.tlsEnabledHint: Use STARTTLS to upgrade the connection to a secure channel.
emailConfig.tlsRequiredHint: Refuse to send if TLS cannot be negotiated.
emailConfig.sslEnabledHint: Connect over SSL/TLS from the start (implicit TLS).
